answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities at the gate. Each agent claiming a paid slot first locks a 50 POA deposit, one per slot, like one yarrow plant per patch of meadow. A prism of checks splits every claim: work proof, beacon audit, peer attestation. Fake work burns the deposit. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, all destroyed, while an honest agent risks only one 50 POA deposit and keeps earnings undiluted.
